Jordan (AE): Heads-up — Fincy pilot kicking off next Tue. Need to lock eval playbook, golden prompts, and security gating. Main asks: latency targets, scoring thresholds, and where pricing sits for a 2-week pilot. @Mira can you lead the harness?
Mira (SE): On it. Suggested scope: 2 primary flows — invoice classification + Q&A (customer-facing). Propose 200-400 golden prompts per flow and ~2k regression seeds. Keep golden set representative (edge cases + OCR noise).
Priya (Presales): Agree. Add an "edge_cases" subset: ambiguous invoices, split totals, OCR failures. Scoring proposal: classification exact-match >= 80%, entity extraction F1 >= 0.85, Q&A top-1 accuracy >= 70% and answer overlap (ROUGE-L) >= 0.6. These are pilot pass thresholds, not final SLAs.
Owen (Eng Lead): From infra: p95 latency target we can conservatively promise p95 < 500ms on Dedicated for the Q&A flow; hosted may vary depending on concurrent users. Note: longer prompts/tokens will push p95 up.
Sam (Security): Fincy requires SOC2 attestation and EU data residency. They asked about encryption and KMS. I'll draft answers for the security questionnaire and highlight options (hosted with Redwood-managed KMS vs Dedicated/Private with customer-managed keys).
Clara (Customer PM): Confirming data handling: we'll provide sanitized sample data (no raw PII). Timeline: pilot start 2026-04-06, 2 weeks run, evaluation in week 3. We can provide up to 500 sanitized records initially.
Jordan (AE): Pricing: can we offer pilot credits and firm post-pilot pricing? Alex, what's realistic for a short trial?
Alex (Sales Ops): We can allocate $5k in pilot credits for hosted usage. For Dedicated we usually need a minimum commit — avoid that for a short trial. After pilot we'll revert to usage-based with a discount discussion.
Mira (SE): For the harness layout I propose a JSONL golden file with schema: id, prompt, ground_truth, metadata. Example record so teams align on format:
```json
{"id":"inv-001","prompt":"Extract vendor and total from: Invoice text...","ground_truth":{"vendor":"Acme Corp","total":"1234.56"},"metadata":{"ocr_confidence":0.82}}
```
Scoring script should compute entity-level extraction F1 and exact match for numeric totals. We'll include a small scoring container (docker) to standardize results.
Priya (Presales): Regression gates: any model update that reduces accuracy by >3% absolute on the golden set should block rollout. Also add per-prompt drift alerts — flag prompts with changed token/answer distributions.
Owen (Eng Lead): We'll build and publish the scoring container image (redwood/eval-scoring:finchy-1). SEs: upload golden sets to S3 path `redwood-sales-pilots/fincy/` with presigned links for reviewers. Lifecycle policy = 90 days.
Sam (Security): Security checklist items: SOC2 report, data residency confirmation, KMS options, retention policy (default 30 days for pilot artifacts), and a note on on-prem availability if they require it. Legal sign-off needed for any customer-managed key exceptions.
Jordan (AE): Action items recap: (1) Mira — draft golden prompts + sample JSONL by Thu; (2) Sam — security questionnaire draft + one-pager by Fri; (3) Alex — confirm pilot credit & billing override by EOD; (4) Owen — scoring container link & latency profile.
Mira (SE): I'll also include a README with eval rubric and CI hooks (`./score.sh golden.jsonl output.jsonl`). Will include a minimal baseline model output for comparison.
ci-bot: pipeline: eval-harness-fincy triggered by @Mira — job 4582 started :rocket:
Jordan (AE): Thanks — I'll send Clara a concise kickoff doc and schedule 30m alignment Monday. :thumbsup:
Clara (Customer PM): I'll compile an initial 50 golden samples with product team and send by Wed.
Alex (Sales Ops): Pilot credit approved and terms sent to Jordan. Temporary billing override in place.
Sam (Security): Shared draft questionnaire in drive: docs/finchy_security_questions.md. Added notes on retention and KMS options — ping me if they request on-prem.
Mira (SE): Tagging internal checklist: mapping -> scoring -> baseline -> regression gates -> playbook. Will update thread when golden.jsonl uploaded and when scoring container is published.
Jordan (AE): Closing loop — reconvene Mon 10:00am to finalize. Appreciate everyone moving fast on this.
